info.name: Data-filtering matrix (partial-eval list filtering)
info.description:
Proves OPA partial-evaluation list filtering through the gateway: two tag-gated readers hit the SAME list endpoint and get DIFFERENT row sets (filtered in SQL by the residual), an allow-all subject sees every row, and an empty-grant subject sees none. The decisive contrast is the row SET, not a single 200/403. Run via run-filter-matrix.sh, which mints tokens, bootstraps the team + tag-gated roles, and creates the differently-tagged Categories at run time.

Taggable products (ADR 0025): the same four-way contrast runs against the product list — two tag-gated readers get different product row sets from the same endpoint, the curator sees all rows, the stranger is denied at the coarse gate.

item.name: Reader EMEA lists categories -> only the EMEA row

exec: pm.test('does NOT see the APAC category', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('apac_category_id')));
pm.test('does NOT see the AMER category', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('amer_category_id')));
pm.test('the cut is in SQL: exactly one row', () => pm.expect(ids.length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Reader APAC lists categories -> only the APAC row (different set, same endpoint)

exec: pm.test('does NOT see the EMEA category', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('emea_category_id')));
pm.test('exactly one row (a DIFFERENT set than reader EMEA)', () => pm.expect(ids.length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Stranger (no role definition) lists categories -> 403 (membership is the sole access path)

exec: // Slice B4 (ADR 0018): a stranger with NO role definition is DENIED at the coarse
// type-level gate (membership is the sole access path) — was an empty 200 via the
// realm fallback; now a 403. The which-rows residual is moot when the gate denies.
pm.test('403 Forbidden (no role-def -> coarse gate denies; membership is the sole access path)', () => pm.response.code === 403);

item.name: Reader EMEA lists products -> only the EMEA row (taggable products, ADR 0025)

exec: pm.test('does NOT see the APAC product', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('apac_product_id')));
pm.test('does NOT see the AMER product', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('amer_product_id')));
pm.test('the cut is in SQL: exactly one row', () => pm.expect(ids.length).to.eql(1));

item.name: Reader APAC lists products -> only the APAC row (different set, same endpoint)

exec: pm.test('does NOT see the EMEA product', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('emea_product_id')));
pm.test('does NOT see the AMER product', () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('amer_product_id')));
pm.test('the cut is in SQL: exactly one row', () => pm.expect(ids.length).to.eql(1));
pm.test('exactly the three seeded rows', () => pm.expect(ids.length).to.eql(3));

item.name: Stranger (no role definition) lists products -> 403 (membership is the sole access path)

exec: // Slice B4 (ADR 0018): a stranger with NO role definition is DENIED at the coarse
// type-level product:list gate — the which-rows residual is moot when the gate denies.
pm.test('403 Forbidden (no role-def -> coarse gate denies)', () => pm.response.code === 403);
